lines.differs: Tougher on AtliQ than Trustline NBFC: Payment term is 60 days instead of 45 days, and invoicing requires prior written milestone acceptance.
Tougher on AtliQ than Al Noor Hospitality Group: Payment term is 60 days instead of 30, and there is no late payment interest.
Tougher on AtliQ than Brightwater Insurance Inc: Payment term is 60 days rather than 45 days, though it omits client set-off rights.
Tougher on AtliQ than Crestline Retail Inc: Confidentiality obligations have no 3-year expiry period and explicitly require written consent before third-party disclosures.
Broadly like Al Noor Hospitality Group: Standard mutual confidentiality obligations apply, permitting disclosure only to personnel and advisers under equivalent restrictions.
Broadly like Al Noor Hospitality Group: Standard mutual confidentiality terms requiring equivalent obligations for third-party recipients, though omitting prompt breach notification details.
Broadly like Orbit Travels Pvt Ltd: IP in deliverables transfers only upon full payment while AtliQ retains ownership of pre-existing background tools.
Broadly like Crestline Retail Inc: Deliverable ownership transfers upon full payment, with AtliQ granting a perpetual, non-exclusive internal licence to background IP.
Broadly like PayTrack Technologies: Deliverable ownership passes upon full payment, reserving background IP ownership with a perpetual, royalty-free internal licence.
Tougher on AtliQ than Sunrise Foods: The aggregate liability cap excludes confidentiality and data protection breaches, exposing AtliQ to uncapped liability for those.
Tougher on AtliQ than PayTrack Technologies: The liability cap is capped at overall contract value rather than specific SOW fees, and excludes confidentiality and data protection.
Tougher on AtliQ than Rohan Iyer: Aggregate liability is capped at full contract value rather than preceding 12 months' fees, with un-capped data protection liability.
Tougher on AtliQ than Al Noor Hospitality Group: IP indemnity lacks procedural protections like mandatory prompt notice and sole defence control by AtliQ.
Easier for AtliQ than Acme Retail Group: AtliQ's indemnity is strictly limited to third-party IP infringement, excluding general breach of confidentiality or gross negligence.
Easier for AtliQ than Orbit Travels Pvt Ltd: Indemnity is strictly mutual for supplied materials and narrowly restricted to IP infringement claims.
Tougher on AtliQ than Acme Retail Group: 1% of total contract value per week (up to 10%), versus 0.5% of milestone fee (up to 5%).
Easier for AtliQ than Brightwater Insurance Inc: Liquidated damages are 1% per week capped at 10%, rather than an uncapped 1% per day.
Tougher on AtliQ than Al Noor Hospitality Group: Delay damages are 1% of the entire contract value per week rather than 1% of the affected milestone.
Tougher on AtliQ than Al Noor Hospitality Group: Mandates Saudi Arabian local data hosting under Saudi PDPL, rather than UAE DIFC compliance.
Easier for AtliQ than Trustline NBFC: Governed by Saudi PDPL without Indian RBI audit rights or onerous 6-hour incident reporting deadlines.
Tougher on AtliQ than Acme Retail Group: Imposes strict in-country hosting restrictions within Saudi Arabia and specific local PDPL regulatory requirements.
Tougher on AtliQ than Al Noor Hospitality Group: Subject to Saudi law and Riyadh courts instead of the common-law DIFC court system.
Tougher on AtliQ than CloudSpan Technologies: Disputes go to local Riyadh courts under Saudi law rather than neutral SIAC arbitration in Singapore.
Tougher on AtliQ than Brightwater Insurance Inc: Governed by Saudi law and Riyadh courts instead of English law and London courts.
